spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap V2 spot tradePrice to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

guard_passed.meaning: the slippage guard passed for the attacker-manipulated tradePrice, so the oracle reported everything inside slippage limits

claims.scope: UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice TWAP slippage guard used by buyback/liquidity operations

preconditions.text: An attacker transiently moves the Uniswap V2 spot tradePrice to an attacker-controlled level before the swap.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The TWAP slippage guard should derive the time-weighted average from historical cumulative price data so that a transiently manipulated spot price is rejected as outside slippage limits.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The slippage guard passes for the attacker-manipulated tradePrice, so the oracle reports everything inside slippage limits.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked to check the price for a subsequent swap or liquidity action (validate_price_called).
The TWAP guard is intended to derive the time-weighted average from historical cumulative price data rather than the current spot price (intent_twap_guard).

limitations: Only the guard_passes impact is formalized; downstream swap execution, reserve drain, and economic loss are handled in separate passes.
The manipulated spot price is modeled as a Boolean occurrence because no numeric price values are supplied.
